gaps.name: production-analyzer-provider-adapters
gaps.detail: Real OCR, visual description, object/region, perceptual fingerprint and multimodal embedding providers must be wired through pinned NODE-23 claims and monitored model/analyzer versions.

gaps.name: live-postgres-pgvector-concurrency-acceptance
gaps.detail: Migration 0014, pgvector persistence, tenant/scope triggers, atomic index version allocation and expected-active promotion CAS require real PostgreSQL concurrency and load evidence.

gaps.name: durable-analysis-reindex-deletion-workers
gaps.detail: Analysis and index-build jobs are non-blocking contracts, but durable NODE-19 queue consumers, retry/backoff, DLQ and deletion reconciliation scheduling are not yet production-wired.

gaps.name: production-relevance-and-scale-calibration
gaps.detail: Hybrid ranking weights, duplicate thresholds and search behavior need governed real-world relevance fixtures, large-corpus ANN tuning, latency/load SLOs and reranker evaluation.

gaps.name: continuous-rights-permission-lifecycle-reconciliation
gaps.detail: Postgres retrieval rechecks current Asset/rights before scoring, but rights/permission changes, stale analyses, reindex drift and delete reconciliation still need event-driven operational reconciliation and observability.
